# Graphify Security Reference

These files are immutable test evidence copied from Graphify `0.9.17` at
commit `cb96bdaa0c367bec8d5c5aee5d7c9ebb727e9780`. Zgraphy verifies their pinned
SHA-256 digests before accepting its security-baseline evidence.

Only the files named by `src/security-baseline.v1.json` are included. They
remain available under Graphify's MIT license in `LICENSE`.
